items.teaser: …No beds, medical equipment as staff quarters decay By Jeff Agbodo, Abakaliki ABAKALIKI — Patients and health workers have raised the alarm over the deplorable condition of the Umuebe/Amaovo Primary Health Centre in Amovu Community, Ohaukwu Local Government Area of Ebonyi State.
